note: Creation modes = HOW a reel is constructed (stage, presenter, visual source, voice, pacing, audio, toolchain). Story skeletons (formats.md) are chosen inside a mode. Derived from 90 analysed reels (batch-01: 88, batch-02: 2 new of 21). Playbook per mode: modes/<id>.md. Scripts read: defaults, qa, requires, fallback.

modes.name: Kinetic Explainer
modes.one_liner: Faceless motion graphics: every sentence gets its own designed composition (rebuilt UI, numbers, diagrams, kinetic headlines).
modes.construction: No presenter. Stage = full frame of designed scenes that change every 1.5-3 s, locked to a fast TTS voice-over; kinetic headline or word-synced captions; music bed + functional SFX.
best_for: a tool/repo/feature with a mechanism to show
avoid_when: the payoff is a real-world visual we cannot rebuild
pure opinion with no visualisable claims

modes.name: Presenter + Board
modes.one_liner: A face anchors trust: presenter in the bottom half, motion-graphics board on top; the face returns full-frame for emphasis and the CTA.
modes.construction: Split layout (board top ~55%, presenter bottom). Presenter = AI avatar (Creatify Aurora from a consented portrait) or the user's own recorded clip (--footage). Board scenes as in kinetic. Push-in close-up for CTA.
avoid_when: no avatar configured and no footage supplied (falls back to kinetic)

modes.name: Illustrated Story
modes.one_liner: A named character keeps failing and each fix teaches one concept; illustrated chapters, a growing progress stack, and a callback twist at the end.
modes.construction: Problem-ladder narrative with a fictional protagonist (never a real person). Consistent illustration style (generated with one locked style prompt + a character reference) or diagram scenes; mono chapter labels; persistent progress tracker; calm 180-200 wpm VO; quiet bed; ends on a punchline, soft or no CTA.
best_for: abstract systems (AI engineering, security layers, money flows)
evidence: Creator 25 — The 8 Layers of AI Engineering (best storytelling in corpus)

modes.name: Newsroom Brief
modes.one_liner: Breaking-news treatment: persistent banner, real headlines highlighted as they are read, a fast chronology, then 'here's where it gets crazy' and 'but here's the catch'.
modes.construction: Signal theme, red BREAKING lower-third banner for the whole reel, real article screenshots (`source` scenes) with outlet + date chip and highlighter sweep synced to VO, date stamps, official logos/og images, tense pulse music, cuts every ~1.8 s. Allegation language for people; outlets cited on screen.
avoid_when: no reputable outlet has covered it yet (use receipts or quicktake)

modes.name: Receipts (Evidence Read-along)
modes.one_liner: The primary sources are the stage: tweets, blog posts, papers and READMEs appear and get highlighted line by line as the voice reads them, building to an honest verdict.
modes.construction: Real-page screenshots (`source`) and code cards with highlights timed to the spoken words, zoom to the exact line, skeptical journalist voice, third-party tests and fine print, verdict pill at the end. Every claim is on screen with its source.
best_for: announcements best explained by their own words
avoid_when: highly visual products (use walkthrough or cinematic)
evidence: Creator 05 — tweet highlights synced to VO (shadcn, Andrew Ng, Vercel)

modes.name: Rapid Catalog
modes.one_liner: High-density list: a preview grid of everything up front, then items fly past with an i/N counter, ending on a screenshot-worthy cheat sheet.
modes.construction: ToC/grid preview hook (open loop), carousel or item cards with i/N and a progress bar, 1-3 s per item (deep list: one demo per item, 5-8 s), restraint advice, final dense sheet with a 'Screenshot this' stamp, save/share or withheld-bonus CTA.
evidence: Creator 63 — 30 best Claude plugins (carousel + progress dots)
Creator 62 — 45 places to launch (quiz counter + cheat sheet)

modes.name: Screen Walkthrough
modes.one_liner: Show, don't tell: one app window where a cursor types, clicks and zooms through the exact steps, before-and-after, 'Step 1… Step 5'.
modes.construction: Before→after hook, then a persistent styled app frame (wallpaper, rounded corners, shadow) with a gliding cursor, typing, click pulses and auto-zoom to each action; spoken 'Step N' signposts; recap of why it works; CTA for the full guide. Visual source: rebuilt UI or real screenshots; real capture only when browser_capture is enabled.

modes.name: Cinematic Hype
modes.one_liner: Spectacle first: AI-generated hero shots, film-slate HUD, condensed caps type and cuts every 1-2 s on a loud bed.
modes.construction: Generated video b-roll (Seedance/Veo) or generated stills with camera moves, slate HUD (corner brackets, timecode, scene n/N), big condensed uppercase headlines, count-ups, risers and impacts, loud music bed; VO stays fast and continuous.
best_for: AI video/image/3D tools whose output IS the hook
sci-fi framed tech (simulations, robotics, world models)
avoid_when: no video_gen or image budget (falls back to kinetic with stills)

modes.name: Silent Showcase
modes.one_liner: No voice at all: a stunning result on screen, three to six text beats cut on the music's beat, built to loop.
modes.construction: Music-only (beat-synced cuts from detected beats), on-screen text carries the whole message in short lines, result shown in the first second, 12-25 s so it loops, end card with the comment keyword. Strong visual required (generated, captured or rebuilt).
avoid_when: anything that needs explanation or nuance

modes.name: Quick Take (Source Frame)
modes.one_liner: Same-day reaction: a persistent headline sticker over the source itself (launch video, README, post), zoomed to what matters, plus one sharp insight and a verdict.
modes.construction: Hook sticker stays the whole reel; the source media (official video/og image/README screenshot) sits on stage with zoom-to-section synced to VO; 20-35 s; one non-obvious insight beyond the press release; keyword CTA. Can be silent (music + headline) when speed matters most.
best_for: when official media already shows the product well
evidence: Recordly — cut-out presenter over README zoom-to-section (batch-02)
